data.name: ShardWars
data.detailed_description:
Shard Wars is an atmospheric VR sci-fi strategy game set on the planet Nythár Prime, where clans fight for the rare Shard — a source of energy, power, and freedom. Lead your clan, gather resources, capture ancient structures, and fight under the constant surveillance of the mysterious Curators.

As the captain of the Sovak clan, you decide the strategy, manage resources, and shape the fate of your people in an immersive VR experience filled with tension, exploration, and tactical combat.

For generations, the planet Nythár Prime has remained under the ruthless control of the Curators. They do not rule through force, but through surveillance. They see everything. And those who break their rules disappear without a trace. Driven by fear, humanity retreated beneath the surface, surviving in isolated family clans.

Then the planet opened. Cracks across the surface began to glow, and the Shard returned — an ancient source of energy, currency, and power. The Curators offered only one path to freedom. Those who seek it must fight. And so the ShardWars began. Clan against clan. A brutal conflict for control of the Shards, bound by strict and unforgiving rules. Every captain commands their own forces, gathers resources, and captures ancient structures. Failure means death. Losing everything means the destruction of the entire clan. The Curators never fight themselves. They only watch, control, and keep the conflict alive.

But legends still remain. Stories of a captain who survived. Of a clan that did not fall. They say he claimed the final Shard and earned his freedom. You were born in darkness. You are Sovak. Now you are a captain. And somewhere out there… the final Shard may still exist.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 44 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 / AMD Radeon RX 9070
  • Storage: 44 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 3
